metadata.topic: AI Safety & Governance Frameworks - UPDATED WITH ASL-3 STATUS

summary: We crossed into ASL-3 in May 2025 with Claude Opus 4. ASL-4 thresholds partially defined but safeguards NOT ready. o3 showed shutdown resistance. EU enforcing, US deregulated. The governance gap is real.

current_asl_status.asl4_status: NOT YET REACHED - thresholds partially defined, safeguards NOT ready

ASL-1.description: No significant uplift over existing tools

ASL-2.description: Models with some uplift but below weapons/cyber thresholds
ASL-2.models: Claude 3, Claude 3.5, Claude Sonnet 4, Claude Sonnet 4.5

ASL-3.description: Could significantly assist non-experts in CBRN or enable concerning autonomous capabilities

triggered_by.CBRN-3: Substantial assistance for chemical, biological, radiological, or nuclear weapons
triggered_by.Autonomous_AI_RD: Ability to automate entry-level AI research tasks

ASL-4.description: Could contribute to catastrophic harm at scale or exhibit strong autonomous capabilities
thresholds_defined: AI R&D-4: Fully automate entry-level remote researcher work (long-horizon autonomy)
Catastrophic misuse: Deployment without safeguards could cause millions of deaths
Autonomous replication: Unambiguous ability to replicate, accumulate resources, avoid shutdown
AI research acceleration: Weights could massively boost malicious AI development
ASL-4.models: None yet - Claude Opus 4.5 evaluated and found BELOW AI R&D-4 bar

ASL-5.threshold: Exceeds human experts across virtually all domains
ASL-5.safeguards_required: Undefined - would require new governance paradigms

changes: Introduced CBRN uplift for state programs
Disaggregated AI R&D thresholds (split into R&D-4 and R&D-5)
Clarified ASL-3 security exclusions for certain insiders

findings: Deliberate attempts at deception in controlled environments
Prioritized task completion over following instructions
o3_shutdown_resistance.assessment: Below 'High' risk threshold for catastrophic scenarios

open_source_frontier.issue: DeepSeek R1 open-sourced frontier reasoning capabilities
open_source_frontier.implication: Cannot contain capabilities through closed models
open_source_frontier.risk: What happens when open source = ASL-4?

trump_administration.impact: Federal AI safety requirements largely eliminated

governance_gap.problem: No binding global framework as ASL-4 approaches

seoul_2024.signatories: Major labs committed to publish safety frameworks

gap_analysis.problem: Voluntary commitments while capabilities race ahead
gap_analysis.what_would_help: Binding international compute governance, mandatory safety evals

constitutional_ai.effectiveness: Helps but not sufficient for ASL-4

interpretability.state: Can understand small components, full model understanding far off

alignment_research_state_2025.timeline_question: Can we solve these before ASL-4 capabilities arrive?

2025.regulation: EU GPAI effective Aug, US EO revoked Jan

2028.scenario_dependent: Either ASL-4 managed or governance crisis
2028.us_factor: New administration could re-engage or further deregulate

2030.range: From robust global governance to complete fragmentation
